title_en: What Would You Do with One Free Year?
title_cn: 如果有一整年自由时间，你会做什么
content_en: Imagine waking up one morning and discovering that you have an entire year with no job, no deadlines, and no major responsibilities. At first, this might sound like a dream, but having so much freedom can also be challenging. Without a clear plan, you might spend your days watching videos, sleeping late, or worrying about what to do next. I would use the first few weeks to rest and explore things I had always wanted to try. Then I would choose a few meaningful goals, such as learning a language, traveling slowly, or building a small project. I would also leave enough room for unexpected opportunities. A free year does not have to be filled with achievements. Sometimes the most valuable thing is having time to understand yourself and discover what truly matters. When the year ends, I hope I would return to ordinary life with new experiences, clearer priorities, and a stronger sense of direction.
content_cn: 想象一下，某天早晨醒来，你发现自己拥有整整一年的时间，没有工作、没有截止日期，也没有重大的责任。起初，这听起来可能像一场美梦，但拥有如此多的自由也可能是一种挑战。如果没有明确的计划，你可能会把时间花在看视频、睡懒觉，或者担心接下来该做什么上。我会先用最初的几个星期休息一下，并尝试那些一直想做的事情。然后，我会选择几个有意义的目标，比如学习一门语言、慢慢旅行，或者建立一个小项目。我也会给意想不到的机会留出足够的空间。自由的一年不必充满各种成就。有时候，最有价值的事情是拥有时间去了解自己，发现什么才真正重要。一年结束时，我希望自己能带着新的经历、更清晰的优先顺序，以及更明确的人生方向，重新回到日常生活中。

title_cn: 如果可以选择，你想在哪里生活
content_en: If I could live anywhere in the world, I would not simply choose the most famous or expensive city. I would look for a place where daily life feels comfortable and meaningful. Good weather, clean air, and convenient public transportation would be important, but they would not be enough on their own. I would also want friendly neighbors, interesting places to explore, and a community where people care about one another. Living near the ocean might be wonderful because the sea can make ordinary days feel more peaceful. However, I would need to consider practical questions, such as the cost of living and access to work. A beautiful location is not always a suitable home. In the end, I believe the best place to live is somewhere that supports both personal growth and everyday happiness. Home is not just a point on a map; it is a place where you can build a life that feels right.
content_cn: 如果我可以生活在世界上的任何地方，我不会仅仅选择最有名或最昂贵的城市。我会寻找一个日常生活舒适而有意义的地方。好天气、清新的空气和便利的公共交通都很重要，但仅有这些还不够。我还希望拥有友好的邻居、有趣的探索场所，以及一个人们彼此关心的社区。住在海边可能很美好，因为大海能让平凡的日子变得更加宁静。不过，我也需要考虑一些现实问题，比如生活成本和工作机会。一个美丽的地方并不总是适合居住的家。最终，我认为最适合生活的地方，是一个既能支持个人成长，又能带来日常幸福感的地方。家不只是地图上的一个点，它是一个你能够建立起理想生活的地方。

title_en: What Kind of Future Do We Want?
title_cn: 我们希望拥有怎样的未来
content_en: When people talk about the future, they often imagine faster technology, taller buildings, and more powerful machines. These things may improve our lives, but they do not automatically create a better world. We should also ask whether people will have enough time to rest, whether children will receive a good education, and whether everyone will have a fair chance to succeed. A future built only around economic growth could leave many important human needs behind. I hope we can create communities where technology serves people instead of controlling them. I also want a cleaner environment, stronger relationships, and more opportunities for people to learn throughout their lives. Of course, no single person can decide what the future will look like. However, our daily choices influence the direction of society. The future is not simply something that happens to us. It is also something we help create through our actions, decisions, and shared values.
content_cn: 当人们谈论未来时，他们常常会想象更快的科技、更高的建筑和更强大的机器。这些事物或许能改善我们的生活，但它们并不会自动创造一个更美好的世界。我们还应该思考：人们是否有足够的时间休息，孩子们能否接受良好的教育，以及每个人是否都有公平的成功机会。一个只围绕经济增长建立的未来，可能会忽视许多重要的人类需求。我希望我们能够创造这样的社区：科技服务于人，而不是控制人。我也希望拥有更清洁的环境、更牢固的人际关系，以及更多让人们终身学习的机会。当然，没有任何一个人能够决定未来会是什么样子。然而，我们日常的选择会影响社会发展的方向。未来并不只是发生在我们身上的事情，它也是我们通过行动、决定和共同价值观参与创造的东西。

title_en: The World I Want to Leave Behind
title_cn: 我希望留给后人的世界
content_en: When I think about the world I want to leave behind, I do not imagine a perfect place without problems. Every generation faces challenges, and no society can solve everything at once. What matters to me is whether we leave future generations with more possibilities than we had. I hope they can breathe clean air, enjoy nature, receive a good education, and live without unnecessary fear. I also hope they grow up in a society that respects differences and gives people the freedom to think for themselves. These goals may sound ambitious, but they begin with ordinary choices. We can reduce waste, treat others fairly, share useful knowledge, and take responsibility for the places where we live. We may never see the full results of these actions. Still, that does not make them meaningless. A better world is not something we simply inherit. It is something we build, protect, and pass on to the people who come after us.

scene: Reviewing the past and planning ahead
content_en: Looking back on the past can bring mixed feelings. We may remember happy moments, difficult decisions, and opportunities we failed to take. Sometimes we wish we had acted differently, but regret cannot change what has already happened. What it can do is help us understand our choices and avoid repeating the same mistakes. I have learned that progress does not always look impressive from the outside. Some important changes happen quietly, through small habits and ordinary decisions. Moving forward does not mean forgetting the past or pretending that everything was perfect. It means accepting what happened while remaining open to new possibilities. Instead of judging ourselves only by our failures, we should also recognize the courage it took to keep going. The future will bring challenges we cannot predict, but our past experiences can prepare us to face them with greater confidence. We cannot rewrite yesterday, but we can make better choices today.

content_en: One of my biggest strengths is that I enjoy learning new things. When I become interested in a subject, I naturally want to understand how it works and how I can use that knowledge. This curiosity helps me solve problems and see situations from different perspectives. However, it also has a weakness. I sometimes become interested in too many ideas at the same time, which makes it difficult to finish what I start. I may spend hours planning a new project and then lose focus when another idea appears. In the past, I thought I simply needed more motivation, but now I understand that I need better habits and clearer priorities. I try to choose one important task, divide it into smaller steps, and complete each step before moving on. I do not expect to become perfect. I just want to use my strengths wisely while working patiently on the areas where I need to improve.

scene: Reflecting on lessons still being learned
title_en: The Things I Am Still Learning
content_en: There are many things I am still learning, even as I grow older. I am learning to be patient when results take longer than expected. I am learning to listen carefully instead of preparing my reply while someone else is speaking. I am also learning that being wrong is not something to be ashamed of. It can be an opportunity to discover a better way of thinking. Another lesson is that I cannot control every situation, no matter how carefully I plan. Sometimes I need to accept what I cannot change and focus on what I can do. I am still learning how to balance ambition with rest, and independence with asking for help. title_en: A Letter to My Future Self
content_en: Dear future me, I wonder where you are now and what your life looks like. I hope you are healthy, curious, and still excited about discovering new things. Please remember the dreams that once gave you energy, but do not be afraid to let go of goals that no longer fit your life. I hope you have treated yourself with patience and other people with kindness. If things have not gone as expected, do not judge yourself too harshly. You have always been allowed to begin again. scene: Comparing your past and present self
content_en: Sometimes I look at old photos or remember conversations from years ago and realize how much I have changed. My interests are different, my priorities have shifted, and I respond to problems in new ways. Some changes happened because of important experiences, while others came from small decisions repeated over time. I used to think that changing my mind meant I was inconsistent, but now I see that it can be a sign of learning. As we gain experience, we often discover that our earlier beliefs were incomplete. Of course, not every change is positive. We may become more cautious or lose some of our original enthusiasm. That is why it is useful to ask whether our changes are taking us closer to the people we want to become. I do not need to remain exactly the same person I was before. What matters is growing in a direction that reflects my values and helps me live more honestly.

scene: Reflecting on a year of English learning
content_en: Learning English has been a journey of small steps rather than a quick transformation. At the beginning, I often understood written sentences but struggled to follow natural conversations. Some speakers talked too quickly, and I could not always recognize familiar words when they were spoken. Instead of giving up, I started listening to short videos, repeating useful sentences, and reading topics that interested me. Gradually, I became more comfortable with different accents and ways of expressing ideas. I still make mistakes, especially when speaking, but I no longer expect myself to sound perfect. I have learned that communication is more important than using complicated words. Every new expression I understand and every conversation I complete gives me a little more confidence. My English is not finished, and perhaps it never will be. There will always be something new to learn. What matters is that I can now understand more, express more, and continue learning with greater confidence.
content_cn: 学习英语是一段由许多小步骤组成的旅程，而不是一次迅速的蜕变。刚开始时，我经常能看懂书面句子，却很难跟上自然的日常对话。有些人说得太快，即使是熟悉的单词，在听到它们时我也不一定能辨认出来。我没有放弃，而是开始听短视频、重复实用句子，并阅读自己感兴趣的话题。渐渐地，我对不同的口音和表达观点的方式变得更加适应。现在我仍然会犯错，尤其是在口语方面，但我不再要求自己说得完美。我已经明白，交流比使用复杂的词汇更重要。每一个新学会的表达，以及每一次完成的对话，都会让我多一分信心。我的英语学习还没有结束，也许永远不会结束。总会有新的东西值得学习。重要的是，现在我能理解更多、表达更多，并且能够带着更大的信心继续学习。

sentences.explanation: 现在完成时表示持续到现在的经历；rather than表示而不是。

sentences.sentence_en: At the beginning, I often understood written sentences but struggled to follow natural conversations.
sentences.sentence_cn: 刚开始时，我经常能看懂书面句子，却很难跟上自然的日常对话。

chunks.meaning: 我经常能理解书面句子

chunks.text: but struggled to follow natural conversations.
chunks.meaning: 但很难跟上自然的日常对话

sentences.explanation: struggle to do表示努力做某事但有困难；follow在这里表示跟上谈话内容。

sentences.sentence_en: Some speakers talked too quickly, and I could not always recognize familiar words when they were spoken.
sentences.sentence_cn: 有些人说得太快，即使是熟悉的单词，在听到它们时我也不一定能辨认出来。

chunks.text: and I could not always recognize familiar words
chunks.meaning: 而我也不总能辨认熟悉的单词

sentences.explanation: could not always表示并非总能；when引导时间状语从句，使用被动语态。

sentences.sentence_en: Instead of giving up, I started listening to short videos, repeating useful sentences, and reading topics that interested me.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我没有放弃，而是开始听短视频、重复实用句子，并阅读自己感兴趣的话题。

chunks.text: I started listening to short videos,
and reading topics that interested me.
chunks.meaning: 并阅读让我感兴趣的话题

sentences.explanation: instead of后接动名词；start后可接动名词；that引导定语从句。

sentences.sentence_en: Gradually, I became more comfortable with different accents and ways of expressing ideas.
sentences.sentence_cn: 渐渐地，我对不同的口音和表达观点的方式变得更加适应。

chunks.text: different accents and ways of expressing ideas.
chunks.meaning: 不同的口音和表达观点的方式

sentences.explanation: become comfortable with表示逐渐适应；way of doing表示做某事的方式。

sentences.sentence_en: I still make mistakes, especially when speaking, but I no longer expect myself to sound perfect.
sentences.sentence_cn: 现在我仍然会犯错，尤其是在口语方面，但我不再要求自己说得完美。

chunks.text: but I no longer expect myself to sound perfect.
chunks.meaning: 但我不再要求自己听起来完美

sentences.explanation: make mistakes表示犯错；no longer表示不再；expect somebody to do表示期待某人做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: I have learned that communication is more important than using complicated words.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我已经明白，交流比使用复杂的词汇更重要。
sentences.explanation: more...than...表示比较；than后接动名词短语。

sentences.sentence_en: Every new expression I understand and every conversation I complete gives me a little more confidence.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每一个新学会的表达，以及每一次完成的对话，都会让我多一分信心。

chunks.meaning: 每一个我理解的新表达
以及每一次我完成的对话

chunks.text: gives me a little more confidence.
chunks.meaning: 都会让我增加一点信心

sentences.explanation: every后接单数名词，两个并列主语由and连接；这里强调每一项带来的作用。

sentences.sentence_en: My English is not finished, and perhaps it never will be.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我的英语学习还没有结束，也许永远不会结束。

chunks.meaning: 我的英语学习还没有结束

chunks.text: and perhaps it never will be.

sentences.explanation: never will be是对前面finished状态的省略重复。

sentences.sentence_en: There will always be something new to learn.
sentences.sentence_cn: 总会有新的东西值得学习。
sentences.explanation: There will be表示将会有；不定式to learn修饰something new。

sentences.sentence_en: What matters is that I can now understand more, express more, and continue learning with greater confidence.
sentences.sentence_cn: 重要的是，现在我能理解更多、表达更多，并且能够带着更大的信心继续学习。

chunks.text: I can now understand more, express more,
chunks.meaning: 现在我能够理解更多、表达更多

chunks.text: and continue learning with greater confidence.
chunks.meaning: 并带着更大的信心继续学习

sentences.explanation: What matters作主语从句；that引导表语从句；三个动词并列。

expressions.example: At the beginning, speaking felt difficult.
I struggle to understand fast conversations.
Practice speaking instead of only memorizing words.
I am becoming comfortable with speaking English.

questions.question: What was the writer's main difficulty at the beginning?
questions.answer: Following natural spoken conversations.
questions.explanation: 作者能看懂书面句子，但很难跟上自然对话。

questions.question: What did the writer do instead of giving up?
options: Listened to videos, repeated sentences, and read interesting topics.
questions.answer: Listened to videos, repeated sentences, and read interesting topics.
questions.explanation: 这些是作者逐渐建立起来的学习习惯。

questions.question: What has the writer learned about language learning?
questions.answer: Communication matters more than using complicated words, and improvement comes through steady practice.
questions.explanation: 文章强调实际交流能力和持续练习，而不是追求复杂词汇或完美表达。
